'may not be eligible for acquisition in your country of residence', with no explanation of what that means for me
Wall of text and a table of percentages. This is where I stopped

used: Total expense ratio row in Basics
unsure_meaning: TER (until I saw Total expense ratio)
1 year +13.79% on the chart vs +17.05% in the table
not_found: Whether I can buy small amounts or part of a unit
Anything in shekels or for Israel
How much it really costs through a broker or app
Whether it's worth it with 300-500 a month

findings.what: The price per unit (EUR 705) is shown big, with nothing about small monthly amounts or savings plans, so it feels out of reach for me

findings.what: Clicking Save in the settings popup jumped me to the bottom of the page and the popup stayed open
The 1-year and 5-year returns differ between the chart and the performance table

The risk section is jargon plus a dense table, with no plain-language meaning
The Basics table is long and full of terms I don't know
